'''Saam''',  ''Saama Kha'', is a nearly extinct [[Kiranti languages|Kiranti]] language spoken in [[Nepal]]. The name ''Saam'' is ambiguous, and shared with neighboring languages.

[[Chukwa language|Chukwa]] may be Saam if it is not Kulung.

==Geographical distribution==
Saam is spoken in the following locations of Nepal (''[[Ethnologue]]'').

*[[Dobhane]] and [[Khatamma]] (Khartangma) VDC's, northern [[Bhojpur District, Nepal|Bhojpur District]], [[Kosi Zone]]; straddling the Irkhuwa River, in Dangmaya, Okharbote, Khartangma, and Dobhane settlements between the [[Phedi River]] and [[Irkhuwa River]]
*[[Phikkal Bazar|Phikkal]] VDC, [[Ilam District]], [[Mechi Zone]]
